# pve_apt_standard_repository (Data Source)

Reads one standard APT repository (identified by its PVE handle) from the node's repository listing (`GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories`). `status` is null when the repository is known to PVE but not configured on the node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up one standard repository on node pve1 by its handle. `status` is
# null while the repository is not configured.
data "pve_apt_standard_repository" "enterprise" {
  node   = "pve1"
  handle = "enterprise"
}

output "pve1_enterprise_status" {
  value = data.pve_apt_standard_repository.enterprise.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Handle that identifies the standard repository (e.g. `enterprise`, `no-subscription`, `ceph-quincy`).
- `node` (String) The cluster node whose repository configuration to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source (`<node>:<handle>`).
- `name` (String) Full name of the repository as reported by PVE.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the configured repository is enabled. Null when the repository is not configured.
